'''''Begonia heracleifolia''''', the '''star begonia''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Begoniaceae]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Begonia heracleifolia'' star begonia |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/2014/Begonia-heracleifolia/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=10 July 2021 |quote=Other common names; ... star leaf begonia }}</ref> It is native to Mexico and northern Central America, and has been introduced to Cuba, [[Hispaniola]], Puerto Rico, and Trinidad and Tobago.<ref name="104828-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:104828-1 |title=''Begonia heracleifolia'' Schltdl. & Cham. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=10 July 2021 }}</ref> A widespread species that is adapted to drought, it possesses considerable genetic and morphological variation, particularly in leaf shape and patterning.<ref>{{cite journal |title=Population history and seed dispersal in widespread Central American ''Begonia'' species (Begoniaceae) inferred from plastome-derived microsatellite markers |year=2013 |last1=Twyford |first1=Alex D. |last2=Kidner |first2=Catherine A. |last3=Harrison |first3=Nicola |last4=Ennos |first4=Richard A. |journal=Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society |volume=171 |pages=260–276 |doi=10.1111/j.1095-8339.2012.01265.x |doi-access=free }}</ref>
